description: Water temperature in Switzerland: every FOEN river station measuring water temperature (raw data, latest reading, and where FOEN publishes it usual_c = median for this calendar day over the station's measuring years with usual_p25_c/usual_p75_c; credit «Surface waters data: Hydrology Division, FOEN»), the three river stations at the outflows of Lake Thun, Lake Geneva and Lake Lucerne (labelled as outflows, FOEN measures no lakes), Lake Zurich from the two City of Zurich water police stations with the last 14 daily means and the typical value for this calendar week (mean over all full years since 2007, calculated by the Swiss Living Index), and Zurich city bath temperatures reported in the last 7 days. Also bathing water quality: the FOEN classification of every reported bathing site (EU Bathing Water Directive, 1 excellent, 2 good, 3 sufficient, 4 poor, 0 not classifiable; credit «Source: FOEN») and the latest Zurich cantonal laboratory sample per site. With canton (2-letter code): river stations in that canton (nearest locality).
